detailExpansion.definition: Source details absent from the indexed numeric FMA concepts (including extension bases), canonical English names and comparable object IDs of the three preceding references, also excluding matching available OBJ hashes. Exact duplicate source positions and triangulated faces are counted once. This index comparison is not a claim of anatomical novelty against references without a complete concept crosswalk. Named source spaces and regions are not presented as additional tissues.

surfaceAudit.spatialCriteria: An authored FJ whole-bone name, a different skeletal source concept whose canonical name includes that complete bone name, and source bounds contained within the whole-bone bounds with a 2 mm tolerance. A diagnostic, not an inferred anatomical relation or a measured surface intersection.
surfaceAudit.note: Every source object is retained. Equal concepts can be alternative representations; a regional bone surface can coincide with its whole bone. Containment is a diagnostic only, never a measured intersection or evidence of a distinct tissue. Visibility is reviewed independently of source identity.

visibility.scope: Technical display review of authored surfaces; no clinical validation or new anatomical relationships claimed

representationGroups.reason: All 2176 source triangles in CX58 are present at exactly the same coordinates in the longer 3242-triangle CX320 source representation; preserve both IDs and display one at a time
Identical original position and triangle arrays; both source identities retained, one displayed at a time
Same authored concept; MM is a shorter, overlapping source representation, not a complementary trajectory. CX keeps the full available trajectory visible by default
Same authored concept; MM is a shorter, overlapping source representation, not a complementary trajectory. CX keeps the full available trajectory visible by default

visibility.regionalBoneDetailPolicy: Nine nearby bone-region surfaces are hidden in the initial body to keep the complete parent bones readable. Each retains its physical mesh, name and selectable source ID and is revealed on selection. These parts do not replace the complete bones.
visibility.preservedContext: Intervertebral discs and the two femoral-head ligaments remain displayed with the corresponding bones. Other shared-concept vascular branches remain independent; a shared FMA alone is not a duplication criterion.
visibility.measurement: Independent source-space Blender BVH nearest-triangle audit, source millimetres, up to 200 vertices and 100 triangle centroids per direction; sampled distances are not a clinical or exhaustive intersection certification
